I will buy some DAP for planting and urea for top-dressing, though not as much as the extension officer recommends because cash is tight. I will use improved seed since my neighbors have shown me it yields better with the rains we get here. My wife and I will do most of the work ourselves, but for planting and weeding on this size of plot I will need to hire a few people to help.
